language.name: Aldervale Keynote
language.rationale: Reflecting 140 years of scholarly authority, this design language combines warm parchment panels with deep Aldervale navy typography and a disciplined brass hairline rule. Source Serif 4 and measured reveal motion provide an understated, intellectual presence on dark stage streams.

notes: structure and spacing: platform-owned (balanced density - 25/33px padding, 11px line gap, at scale 1)
accent: a rule across the top of the panel, one clear space above the words
motion: reveal at measured pace → preset line-reveal
